ai_emerging_top10.description: Agent framework for the JVM. Pronounced Em-BAY-bel /ɛmˈbeɪbəl/
ai_emerging_top10.about: Agent framework for the JVM. Pronounced Em-BAY-bel /ɛmˈbeɪbəl/
ai_emerging_top10.readme_highlight: Embabel (Em-BAY-bel) is a framework for authoring agentic flows on the JVM that seamlessly mix LLM-prompted interactions with code and domain models. Supports intelligent path finding towards goals. Written in Kotlin but offers a natural usage model from Java. From the creator of Spring.
